# popnow-comfyui

> ComfyUI custom node pack (Python package `popnow_nodes`, node category "PopNow") that runs every PopNow AI video, image and audio model in the cloud as a ComfyUI node: Kling, Seedance, Wan, Vidu, MiniMax, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Flux, Suno and more. No GPU and no model downloads; billed in PopNow credits (1 credit = $0.001).

Install: Comfy Registry `popnow-comfyui` (ComfyUI Manager > search PopNow, or `comfy node install popnow-comfyui`), or `cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes && git clone https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-comfyui`, then restart ComfyUI (ComfyUI Registry release coming). No extra Python dependencies. Auth: Settings > PopNow > API key, or the `POPNOW_API_KEY` environment variable (`sk-popnow-...`, from https://popnow.ai/api/console/keys).

## Nodes

- One node per model, type `PopNow_<call name with non-alphanumerics as _>` (for example `PopNow_minimax_h3_image_to_video` for `minimax/h3/image-to-video`), under `PopNow/<Video|Image|Audio>/<maker>`. Inputs come from the model's `inputSchema`; outputs are IMAGE (+ MASK `alpha` for background removal), VIDEO (+ `last_frame`), AUDIO or STRING, plus `task_id`.
- `PopNowGenerate` ("PopNow Generate"): inputs `model` (call name), `prompt`, `options` (JSON), optional `image` and `image_field`; outputs `image`, `url`, `path`. Same node type as the single-file node on https://popnow.ai/docs/comfyui.
- `PopNow_LoRA` ("PopNow LoRA"): `source` (file in ComfyUI/models/loras, Hugging Face repo id or page, Civitai page, or https link) and `scale`; chain into a LoRA model's `loras` input.

## Behaviour

- Catalog: `GET /api/v1/models?includeSchema=1` at startup when a key is set (cached), else the bundled `data/catalog-snapshot.json`.
- Each run: uploads inputs (`POST /api/v1/common/upload-url`, PUT, `POST /api/v1/files/{id}/commit` -> `popnow://f/...`), `POST /api/v1/jobs/quote`, `POST /api/v1/jobs/createTask` with `Idempotency-Key`, `quoteId` and `expectedCredits`, polls `GET /api/v1/jobs/recordInfo`, downloads outputs from signed URLs. LoRA imports use `POST /api/v1/files/import`.
- Price badge on every node from the catalog's `credits` rules; optional "Max credits per run" limit stops a run before anything is held.
- Envelope `{code, msg, data, request_id}`; errors show `PopNow <code>` plus a fix and the request_id.
